## Change

Describe the customer-visible behavior and the smallest implementation boundary.

## Evidence

- [ ] Focused tests added or updated
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Native browser evidence when WebMCP behavior changed
- [ ] Exact browser/client version and evidence level recorded
- [ ] No prompts, tool payloads, credentials, DOM content, or private source added to reports

## Compatibility

List changed package contracts, browser/client profiles, migration behavior, or `None`.

## Release

- [ ] User-facing documentation updated
- [ ] Version change required
- [ ] No release required
